assumptions: Stable upstream identity is supplied by governed discovery/model providers.
Camera frames are supplied by the governed external camera owner.
Astronomy morphology or density hints retain their upstream authority and are only consumed as presentation context here.
limitations: Generated galaxy density particles, dust cues, clusters, morphology components, cosmic-web placements and identity-keyed presentation coordinates are presentation-only and are not calibrated observations.
The provider does not own camera, semantic scale, canonical selection, temporal state, persistence, registry semantics, central resource admission, renderer backend or astronomical equations.
V1X-02 is consumed only for its governed camera projection seam and neighborhood source projection helpers; V2X-03 Universe and Galaxy layout never call the V1X-02 representation() path.

Decorative particles are never canonical discovery results and are never selectable or navigable; explicit upstream non-selectable/non-navigable constraints are preserved by region and neighborhood refinement.
Region interpolation communicates continuity but is not a claim of physical motion or canonical region boundaries; reduced-motion mode removes the continuous blend.
Canonical-key snapshots are bounded, acyclic and isolated from upstream mutation; malformed or oversized keys fail closed.
Each macrocosm request scans at most 4096 upstream records before the smaller quality/materialization caps are applied; oversized requests fail closed.

Canonical-object upload packets are at most one modeled draw and 96 packed instances; Galaxy decorative batching remains at most three modeled draws. GPU, driver and heap memory are not measured by this lane.

fidelity.validity: Deterministic identity-keyed macrocosm presentation for Universe, Galaxy, Region and Neighborhood with cosmic-web density variation, morphology-aware 3D placement, progressive refinement and externally governed camera projection.
fidelity.resolution: At most 4096 upstream records scanned per request, 64 represented upstream entities, 96 region children, 96 canonical packed instances and bounded quality-profile decorative fields; Galaxy decorative batching remains at most 3 draws and canonical-object batching at most 1 modeled draw.
fidelity.uncertainty: Generated spatial, density, depth and morphology cues are presentation-only; stronger upstream positions or facts retain their declared authority without promotion.
